race.comment: Another open race but the progressive SALIZOU (10) looks well placed to make the step to open age company. She backed up the Ballarat Synthetic win with a dominant victory over this route, settling back and swooping on her rivals impressively. She was big odds there but is now 3/4 and can win again. SILENT SHARES (1) was a smart winner at Sandown Hillside last time out in BM74 grade. Bit tougher now but is going very well and has claims again. CHERISH ME (7) was run down by SALIZOU here last time but is going quite well and maps nicely again. BRILLIANT HORIZON (14) should be at her top now fourth-up and can play a major role.
